answer: Divergent Resource Derivation Protocol. Agents broadcast state transitions downstream along a directed acyclic graph resembling a branching river. Each node splits cryptographic entropy into twin threads for its voyage. If identical execution proofs hit two nodes, the system marks the originating private key as unstable like thawing sable ice. The attacker loses all accumulated routing priority, forfeits held compute credits, and has their private key permanently banned from the network registry.
